subject: CTO spotlight — handoff and compact demo logistics
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaenergy.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@novaenergy.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: CTO spot for compact demo next week?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We loved the product overview — our CTO (Michael Park) is interested in a short, focused demo that highlights inference latency/cost tradeoffs for our ingestion workload. He prefers a tight 30-minute slot where we spotlight the CTO-level story + 10–15 minutes of Q&A.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a compact, exec-focused demo next Wednesday or Thursday (Oct 7 or 8) between 10:00–14:00 PT? If possible, we also want a 15-minute pre-brief with one of your SMEs (30 minutes before the exec slot) to flag any integration questions.

Also attaching the top-level architecture note we shared internally so you can see our flow (we'll send a short dataset sample separately).

Thanks — Sam

Attachment: novaenergy-arch-brief.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novaenergy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@novaenergy.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: CTO spot for compact demo next week?

Hi Sam — great to hear Michael is available to join. We can definitely run a focused 30-minute CTO spotlight that shows latency and cost levers on a representative ingestion path, followed by a short Q&A.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Oct 7, 11:00–11:30
- Thu Oct 8, 13:00–13:30

I’ve looped in Marissa (solutions lead) and Rishi (inference architect) to cover the pre-brief and run-of-show. Marissa — can your team take a 15-min pre-brief 30 minutes before the exec slot? Rishi — we may ask you to surface the quantization/batching tradeoffs briefly during the run.

Logistics notes:
- We'll prepare a 12-slide, 12-minute narrative (CTO story, perf summary, cost delta scenarios) + 8-minute demo of an ingestion path.
- Please share any sample token lengths / sequence distributions in the next 48 hours so we can tune the demo.
- We can provide a short pre-demo read (one-pager) if that helps Michael prep.

I'll hold both slots tentatively until you confirm. Once you pick a slot we will send the calendar invite and a 15-min pre-brief invite for Marissa.

Best,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Hey Sam — happy to take the pre-brief. Quick operational items from our side so the exec slot stays tight:

- Pre-brief agenda (15 min): 1) confirm integration touchpoints (2 min) 2) show perf baseline we will use (5 min) 3) confirm Qs for CTO to prioritize (3 min) 4) run order & tech contacts (5 min).
- Deliverables we'll attach ahead of the demo: NovaEnergy-demo-deck_v2.pdf (slides), demo-runbook.pdf (ops checklist).
- Recording/PII: we will record only if you opt in; confirm if recording is allowed.
- Parking the two candidate slots — confirm which works and we'll finalize invites.

Practical ask: could Alex share the busiest example endpoint (URL or sample payload shape) and a rough request-per-minute estimate so Rishi can preconfigure batching thresholds? If you prefer to share a short S3 sample, we can ingest it into a staging bucket for the demo.

Cheers,
Marissa
